import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,base64,sys
L=Path.cwd()
for n,p in [('bunkbed-journal',2),('bunkbed-journal',11),('bunkbed-journal',14),('bunkbed-thesis',172),('bunkbed-leander',37),('bunkbed-leander',38)]:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f',str(p),'-l',str(p),'-scale-to','1600','-singlefile','-png',str(L/('inputs/sources/'+n+'.bytes'))],capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
 q=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(L/'write_lane.py'),f'visual/{n}-{p}.png','--base64'],input=base64.b64encode(r.stdout),capture_output=True);assert q.returncode==0;print(q.stdout.decode().strip())
